builder_plan.scenario: Your workload might fit a smaller or differently structured model.
builder_plan.change: Check for available weights and a compatible runtime before planning a product trial.
builder_plan.baseline: Your current model on identical held-out tasks and the same resource budget.
steps: Locate the paper's implementation and check its license, model support, data needs, and hardware requirements. Stop here if you cannot obtain the required artifacts.
Save a small set of representative product tasks and expected outcomes. Keep evaluation tasks out of any training or tuning, and choose quality and cost limits before running.
Run the baseline and the proposed change on identical inputs. Keep other settings fixed and repeat paired runs to expose variation.
Save per-task outputs, failures, timings, and all usage costs. Review regressions before expanding the test.
builder_plan.measure: Task success, latency, memory, context limits, and migration cost.
builder_plan.decision: Keep the change only if it meets your preselected quality and latency limits and improves the metric you care about after setup and operating costs. Otherwise retain the baseline. This is an exploration plan, not a validated recommendation.

title: CHARMING: Parallel Edge AI Acceleration Across Tensor Processing and In-Memory Computation
summary: Replaces AIE-only edge inference by partitioning attention heads between the AIE array and an in-DRAM compute unit, with accuracy- and quantization-aware head selection and integrated quantization in the projection stage. Costs include dependence on specific AMD Versal/Alveo platforms, in-memory compute hardware, custom partitioning logic, and potential accuracy loss from head selection and int4 compute. It can fail if the target workload does not fit the assumed head-level partitioning, if int4 degradation exceeds the reported tolerance, or if deployment lacks access to the validated hardware stack.
rationale: The gains are hardware-validated but depend on specialized edge accelerators and in-memory compute that are outside the reader's single-GPU or API-constrained production environment.
technique: Heterogeneous edge inference: AIE plus in-DRAM compute

claims.statement: Replaces AIE-only edge inference by partitioning attention heads between the AIE array and an in-DRAM compute unit, with accuracy- and quantization-aware head selection and integrated quantization in the projection stage. Costs include dependence on specific AMD Versal/Alveo platforms, in-memory compute hardware, custom partitioning logic, and potential accuracy loss from head selection and int4 compute. It can fail if the target workload does not fit the assumed head-level partitioning, if int4 degradation exceeds the reported tolerance, or if deployment lacks access to the validated hardware stack.

Up to 23.6% prefill and 44% decode improvement over AIE-only acceleration; up to 7.6% lower per-layer energy and 24.7% better energy-delay product with int4 x int4 in-memory compute, at near-FP32 accuracy.
